title: PongLens
instructions: Warm and plain spoken, like a coach explaining something useful to another coach. Unhurried and even. Nothing is sold and nothing is hurried. No rising lift at the end of sentences.

lines.text: PongLens is a complete coaching workspace for lessons, students and remote reviews.
Build a coach profile that presents your experience, your approach and the reviews you offer.
lines.label: Coach profile

lines.text: Keep every student's lessons, journal entries, shared materials and matches together, so the whole coaching relationship stays visible.
lines.label: Your students

lines.text: Record lessons as audio or video, and turn each session into a clear journal entry.
lines.label: Lesson recording

lines.text: Share the entries each student needs, so your feedback stays with them between sessions.
lines.label: Shared journals

lines.text: When players send review requests, their matches and questions arrive together.
lines.label: Review orders

lines.text: Choose which orders to accept and keep every active review visible in one place.
lines.label: Review orders

lines.text: Review the match point by point, and connect written, drawn or spoken feedback to the rallies that show it.
lines.label: Delivery and payouts

lines.text: Deliver the finished review through PongLens, with payment and payouts handled for you.
lines.label: Delivery and payouts
